sources.name: Texas Music Office — Industry Directory (Live Music Venues)
sources.remediation: State-run, free, no credential. Region- and category-filterable. Enumerates VENUES (a denominator layer), and separately lists Clubs/Dancehalls/Small Venues and Radio Stations. Music-specific where TABC is alcohol-specific — it sees the all-ages and alcohol-free rooms TABC cannot, and excludes the restaurants TABC wrongly includes.
